Lena Ortiz: Heads-up: Support flagged a customer who saw a provisional token spike after a streaming toolcall timed out and the router retried to another model.
Tom Becker: Can you paste the trace id?
Lena Ortiz: trace=tr_bug_92. Sequence: client->stream_start, provisional written, toolcall invoked, tool timed out and truncated response, router retried to model B, resumed with overlapping prefix, provisional written again. Console shows a sharp provisional blip.
Ravi Desai: Sounds like duplicate provisional writes when resume emits prefix. Our current ledger only dedupes on confirm.
Tom Becker: Quick mitigation: suppress provisional spikes in console under 45s and add tooltip explaining reconciliation. That avoids alarming customers while we fix accounting.
Lena Ortiz: Longer term we should propagate a stable session id across handoffs so ledger can dedupe at write time. Edge can generate X-Session-Stable header on start.
Ravi Desai: Agreed. Dedupe key: (stable_id, toolcall_id, prefix_start). If stable_id missing fall back to (trace_id, prefix_hash) and log.`accounting.stable_id_missing`.
Tom Becker: Telemetry: emit accounting.provisional_write and accounting.provisional_dedupe with tags model, route, stable_id. Add Grafana panel for provisional_dedupe rate.
Lena Ortiz: Rollout plan: 1) Edge emits header behind flag (canary), 2) Ledger accepts header and dedupes when present, 3) Console hides provisional spikes <45s.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled for canary env at 1721010100 by Tom Becker
billing-bot: Provisional charge created pc_bug_92 amount=0.18 tokens=540 session=sess_99 trace=tr_bug_92
Tom Becker: I'll add an integration test to simulate mid-stream toolcall timeout -> retry -> resume overlap. Ravi will prototype ledger change.
Ravi Desai: I'll also add reconciler job to tag suspected duplicates until stable_id rollout reaches 100%.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks — circle back after canary run. :thumbsup:
